questions.question: The most reliable source for the proctoring rules of a test is
options: the official instructions from the employer or provider

questions.question: Before a proctored test you should
options: read the rules and prepare ID, device, network and room

questions.question: If the instructions say to keep your face in the camera frame, you should
May you photograph test questions to share later?
questions.explanation: Capturing or sharing questions is not allowed.

questions.question: If your internet connection drops during the test, you should
options: ask a friend to log in
try to reconnect and report through the official support channel
restart the whole device without telling anyone

questions.question: Items on your desk during the test should be
If an instruction is unclear, you should
options: ask the support channel before the test starts
ask another candidate during the test

questions.question: Why do integrity rules exist?
options: To keep results fair for all candidates

questions.question: Identity verification is done to confirm that
options: the person taking the test is the registered candidate
questions.explanation: It confirms who is taking the test.

questions.question: A noisy environment during a proctored test is best handled by
If someone enters the room during the test, you should
options: follow the instructions and report if required, without leaving the frame improperly
questions.explanation: Keep within the rules and use the official channel.

questions.question: Logging in early on the test day helps because it
options: leaves time for identity and system checks

questions.question: Which action is a rule violation?
options: Using unpermitted notes during the test

questions.question: Rough work on paper is allowed only if
A technical problem occurs. What should you note for the support request?
questions.explanation: Time and symptom help support resolve the issue.

questions.question: A candidate sees a question and posts it online to ask for help during the test. This is
questions.explanation: Sharing questions during a test is a violation.

questions.question: The best practice for a trial run is to
options: use the official demo with the same device and network
questions.explanation: A trial run reveals problems early.

questions.question: If the test requires the microphone, you should
options: allow it as instructed and keep the room quiet

questions.question: After a rule violation is alleged, the best response is to
options: be honest and follow the official process
questions.explanation: Honest cooperation is the right course.

questions.question: Honest compliance with proctoring rules mainly protects
options: your own result and the fairness of the test
questions.explanation: It protects you and every other candidate.
